justification: Docs-only change: adds the NDIS deep-dive Modules 1-5 checkpoint (regulatory architecture, market structure, demand nature, buyer constraints, use-case inventory) under docs/. No code paths, no user-facing product surfaces, no database interaction, no build inputs touched. Zero .py/.ts/.tsx files in the diff vs origin/main.

break_it.scenario: Founder acts on an inferred figure or [UNVERIFIED-PRIMARY] tag as if it were verified (e.g. treats the inferred July 2027 cohort size or an F-number derived only from a commentator as ground truth for build scope).
break_it.what_happens: Corpus scope or revenue math is misspecified; a build starts against instruments that turn out to differ from what a direct primary-source read would show.
break_it.how: Every inferred or unverified claim carries an inline tag ([INFERENCE], [UNVERIFIED], [UNVERIFIED-PRIMARY]); the Honesty Ledger at the end lists every gap and how to close it; the checkpoint explicitly stops for owner review before Modules 6-11 build/GTM/verdict decisions.
